changelog:
Major upgrade: ClawHub Finance Skill is now a comprehensive, subscription-based financial suite with expanded features and business focus.

- Transitioned from market-data tracker to AI-powered financial management (expense analysis, budgeting, investments, invoicing, tax optimization).
- Introduced tiered pricing (Personal, Business, Enterprise) and detailed subscription model.
- Enhanced security: bank-level encryption, SOC 2 compliance, read-only access, no credential storage.
- Integrated with ClawHub Swarm Ecosystem for multi-agent workflows and memory sharing.
- Removed legacy scripts and provider-specific documentation for a streamlined, modular architecture.
